Devices.title: Devices
Devices.explanation: A device with a key may send recipes to your inbox without logging in. One key per device, so losing a phone costs one revoke.
Devices.labelPlaceholder: What is this device? (e.g. my iPhone)
Devices.secretWarning: It is shown once and never again. Put it into the Shortcut now.
Devices.shortcutHeading: Setting up the Shortcut on an iPhone
Devices.shortcutIntro: iOS cannot add a web page to the share sheet, so a Shortcut does it instead. Five minutes once, then it is one tap from Instagram, YouTube, Safari and Notes.
Devices.step1: Open the Shortcuts app and create a new shortcut. Name it something you will recognise in a share sheet — "To the cookbook", say.
Devices.step2: Open its settings (the ⓘ button) and turn on "Use with Share Sheet". Under the accepted types, leave URLs and Text on and turn the rest off.
Devices.step3: Add the action "Get Contents of URL" and set it up like this:
Devices.step4: Add "Show Notification" after it, so a share tells you it arrived.
Devices.step5: Share something from Instagram or YouTube and pick your shortcut. It should appear in the inbox within seconds.
Devices.shortcutNote: Only one field is needed: whatever is shared goes into `text`, and the link is dug out of it on this side. That way a share carrying a caption as well as a link keeps both.
Devices.screenshotIntro: A screenshot is one button, and it works on apps that cannot be read any other way. Same key, same endpoint — only the body differs.
Devices.screenshotStep1: A new shortcut, named something like "Screenshot to the cookbook". Under its settings (ⓘ) turn on "Show in Share Sheet" and accept Images only.
Devices.screenshotStep2: Add the action "Base64 Encode" with the shortcut input as its input.
Devices.screenshotStep3: Then "Get Contents of URL", same method, same header as above, and this as the body — the Base64 result goes in place of the placeholder:
Devices.screenshotStep4: Share a screenshot from Photos and pick the shortcut. It appears in the inbox with the picture attached.
Devices.screenshotNote: Without an AI key the picture is still kept and the inbox says what it needs. With one, the recipe is read out of the picture. Nothing is ever refused for want of a key.
